name: sfx_init
notes: verified; audio DMA/INT off; ADKCON 0xFF; $70 -> 0x12616; AddIntServer VERTB Sfx VBLInt pri 0x1E

name: sfx_shutdown
notes: verified; stop all; Delay(5); RemIntServer; restore $70

name: sfx_set_song_channels
notes: verified; D:1E9E = (~mask & 0xF) << 7; masked channels lose the audio interrupt

name: play_sample
notes: verified; period = 0x369E99 / rate (rate<100 -> x1000); start_channel(s+6 len ch period vol 1)

name: start_channel
type: void(u8 *data, long len, int ch, int period, int vol, int repeats)
notes: verified; stops busy channel; record pending; repeats -1 = loop

name: sfx_stop_channel
notes: verified; DMA off; AUDxVOL 0; stop tick = D:04C2

name: sfx_channel_busy
notes: verified; -1 if record data pointer set

name: sfx_set_period_vol
type: void(int ch, int period, int vol)
notes: verified; negative = keep; vol cancels slide

name: sfx_slide_volume
type: void(int ch, int target, long step)

name: sfx_audio_int
notes: verified; counts repeats; stops channel (PER 0x96 VOL 0 DMA off); not in td_functions.json

name: sfx_vbl_server
notes: verified; tick D:04C2; starts pending channels >= 2 ticks after stop; volume slides

name: song_init
notes: verified; AddIntServer VERTB Song VBLInt pri 0x20; volume 0x10

name: song_shutdown
notes: verified; request stop; Delay(3); free instruments; RemIntServer

name: song_load_instruments
notes: verified; songs/<name> in chip RAM; name <= 10 = copy slot n

name: song_set_volume
notes: verified; D:1EF8 = vol<<16; D:1EF0 = step (0 = jump)

name: song_get_volume
notes: verified; D:1EF4 high word or 0 when idle

name: song_start
notes: verified; if installed and music on: request stop + song_setup(d0=6)

name: song_request_stop
notes: verified; state -> 3; wait loop exits at once

name: song_setup
type: asm (a0 song, a1 inst[4], a2 oneshot[4], d0 base)
notes: verified; builds duration table D:0710; state 1

name: song_vbl_server
notes: verified; SMUS player tick; not in td_functions.json

name: smus_find_long
type: asm (a0 base d0 off d1 limit d2 id)
notes: verified; 2-byte steps; carry = found; not in td_functions.json

name: song_play

notes: verified; same song already loaded -> fade in 0x8000

name: song_stop

name: sfx_free_drive

name: radar_beep

name: engine_sound_start

name: bump_update
